name: Lecterns
note: A writable or written book goes on a lectern without one (the item tag lectern_books; used up outside creative mode); its window turns to the previous or next page, to a page by its number or takes the book, a click on its slot takes the book too and the window closes without it; a page turn powers the lectern until its block tick 2 ticks later, every neighbor and the block below strongly, a turn while powered adding nothing; comparators read 1 more than 14 times the page's place, dust connects to it, and a removed lectern's book pops out on top toward its front; the harness traces and a 22-step client scenario match both official servers
deviations: a book put on from the off hand is not modeled
written books' pages are not resolved for the player who puts them on
